name: reasoning-steps
title: Reasoning Steps
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Collapsible list of reasoning or tool steps with pending, active, done, and error states plus a duration.

meta.descriptionEs: Lista colapsable de pasos de razonamiento o herramientas, con estado pendiente, en curso, hecho o error, y duración.

examples.title: Pasos de razonamiento
examples.description: Lista colapsable de pasos de razonamiento o herramientas, con estado pendiente, en curso, hecho o error, y duración.

api.name: steps
api.description: id, title, optional detail, status, and durationMs.

api.name: open / onOpenChange
api.description: Controlled disclosure. defaultOpen defaults to true.

api.name: labels
api.description: title and the four status labels default to English.

docs: Import ReasoningSteps from the installed UI file. Durations are formatted from milliseconds. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has. The item ships no theme, cssVars, or fixed colors.
